definitions.validity_sv: Treårig omcertifiering, fortbildning och medlemskap enligt ACAMS. Kontrollera aktuell status separat.
definitions.validity_en: CAMS is maintained on a three-year recertification cycle with recertification credits earned within it. No official public holder-verification lookup was confirmed on review, so none is recorded.

definitions.validity_sv: Årlig fortbildning och aktuellt medlemskap krävs enligt ACFE. Ett utbildningsdatum bevisar inte aktuell status.
definitions.validity_en: The CFE credential is maintained by an ANNUAL continuing-education compliance obligation, not by a fixed multi-year expiry. The ACFE's Find a CFE directory is opt-in: absence from it is not evidence that a credential is invalid.

definitions.validity_sv: Treårig omcertifiering med fortbildning enligt ASIS. Bevisets aktuella status måste kontrolleras separat.
definitions.validity_en: ASIS board certifications are maintained on a three-year recertification cycle, with continuing professional education recorded through the issuer's own portal. The cycle is the programme's; it is not this holder's expiry date.

definitions.validity_sv: Årliga krav och treårig fortbildningscykel enligt ISACA. Kontrollera aktuell status separat.
definitions.validity_en: ISACA certifications carry an annual CPE minimum and an annual maintenance fee, alongside 120 CPE hours across a three-year reporting period. Annual standing can end BEFORE the three-year date printed on the certificate, so the printed date is not current standing.
